limits: Copy observations count explicit payload-byte writes at identified source statements, not all compiler-generated struct/metadata copies or hardware memory traffic.
Timing binaries omit the copy observer completely and reuse actual DSmall, signed/unsigned lane kernels, typed capture and T66 counting allocator.
Timing captures only repeated invocation after construction; capture encoding/allocation costs are reported by operation observations, not folded into call latency.
Seven host samples per cell, no affinity/frequency control, no universal speed threshold or second ABI claim.
Scalar comparison uses the same saturation contract; its compiler may itself vectorize or synthesize packed operations.
